part: RS485 Modbus RTU soil moisture/temperature probe (buried steel electrodes)
interface: RS485 Modbus RTU, SIM is bus master; slave address 0x01, function 0x03 (read holding registers), registers 0x0000-0x0001
note: PROVISIONAL card, not yet confirmed against the official numbering. gateway/cards/ previously only went up to id 14; the only existing RS485 card (05_rs485_meter.json, id 5) is the energy meter instrument, not this soil probe -- the sensor deck (sensor_decks/05_RS485_industrial_digital_sensors.md) describes the soil probe as a second SIM5 worked example but never assigned it its own id. This card claims the next free id (15) for firmware repo IEEE-BLP-SOILMOIST-RS485. The register map (moisture at 0x0000, soil temp at 0x0001) is likewise inferred from the working Arduino firmware's Modbus request plus the near-universal vendor convention for this instrument family, not a cited datasheet -- confirm the id before treating readings from this card as ground truth. Both moisture_pct's and soil_temp_c's scale were corrected from 0.1 to 0.01 after live confirmation on real hardware (0.1 resolution read soil_temp_c as 305.10 C for an actual 30.51 C, a 10x error; moisture_pct had the same class of error).

measurands.name: moisture_pct
measurands.accuracy: vendor claims ±3% for 0-53% moisture, ±5% above -- per sensor deck, not a cited datasheet; scale confirmed against real hardware on 2026-08-21

measurands.name: soil_temp_c
measurands.accuracy: vendor claims ±0.5 degC -- per sensor deck, not a cited datasheet; scale confirmed against real hardware on 2026-08-21

failure_modes: Modbus timeout/CRC failure: sensor_ok bit drops; a comms fault is not a zero-moisture reading
reading frozen across known-wet/dry changes: stuck slave or bus wiring fault, power-cycle the probe
moisture pinned at 0 or 100: probe pulled from soil, or waterlogged/saturated soil
mounting: steel electrodes fully buried, probe body above grade and rain-protected
